note: Insight → action, per section. Read these as 'what the numbers mean and what to do about it,' refreshed as the data moves.

overall.insight: 145 articles live but only ~2.4 unique users/day — you have supply, not demand. Distribution is the single bottleneck; the content engine is already ahead of the audience.
overall.action: Pick ONE channel to push hard each week (reels or a rare-aroid community) and watch the timeline above for the lift — repeat whatever moves it.

overall.insight: We can't yet see whether readers convert to paying — subscription data lives in RevenueCat, which isn't wired. So 'people read gated articles but don't subscribe' is a hypothesis we can't prove or fix blind.
overall.action: Wire RevenueCat into the dashboard (subscribers, trial→paid, churn) so conversion becomes visible — then we can act on it.

traffic.insight: Most traffic is 'Direct,' which is almost entirely your untagged Instagram bio link — so you can't tell which post drove which visit.
traffic.action: Add UTM tags to the bio link (e.g. ?utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=bio). Then those visits show as Organic Social and attribute to IG.

traffic.insight: Pageviews-per-user is healthy (people read several articles per visit) — depth is fine; it's the top of funnel that's tiny.
traffic.action: Verify Google Search Console + submit the sitemap so the 145 articles start pulling Organic Search traffic, not just Direct.

conversion.insight: Point of failure = the TOP of the funnel, not the CTA or paywall. With ~8 unique users and 0 install-taps in 30 days, there isn't enough traffic to even test whether the install button or the offer is the problem — you can't diagnose a conversion step that nothing reaches.
conversion.action: Don't tweak the CTA/paywall yet — it's premature. Drive traffic first (reels + Search Console). Once a few hundred users flow through, the 'articles that drove install taps' panel will reveal the real conversion leak, and THEN it's worth optimizing.

revenue.insight: 0 subscribers — but that's NOT a paywall problem yet. With ~0 installs there's simply nobody in the app to subscribe. 'Readers don't buy' isn't measurable until installs exist, so don't over-read the zero.
revenue.action: Treat subscriptions as a later milestone. When installs reach a steady trickle, the trial-start vs trial→paid numbers here will show if the paywall/onboarding converts — if trials start but don't convert, front-load the 'aha' (a real ID + care guide) before the ask. Not actionable today.

socials.insight: Reach is 0 on every post — a 0-follower, days-old account is posting into the void. The bottleneck is NOT reel-vs-image, it's that nobody is discovering the account yet.
socials.action: Prioritize distribution before optimization: engage daily in rare-plant communities (follow + comment on target collector accounts), use specific niche hashtags, and lean on reels for explore reach. Don't judge format performance until posts actually reach people.

socials.insight: Reels are still the right format bet (explore-friendly) and the hooks on days 8-46 target retention — but reach has to exist before retention matters.
socials.action: Keep posting reels. The moment reach climbs above 0, compare hooked (🪝) vs non-hooked watch time to validate the hooks; until then it's not measurable.

ops.insight: Field Guide burns ~5/wk and Understory ~3/wk; both drips depend on the queue staying full.
ops.action: Watch the runway tile — top up leaf_queue / guide_queue before either drops under the 2-week warning band.

ops.insight: Your own IP still counts in GA, inflating engagement and New-users % at this low volume.
ops.action: Activate the GA4 internal-traffic filter once real users show up and the numbers start mattering.
